name: Need Navigator
notes: Marketing site v2 for the Need Navigator product (Webriculture). Content is governed by the binding docs in ./docs/: FEATURES.md (audited inventory + Decisions #1-20), BACKUP-CLAIMS.md (backup/encryption wording), SITE-PLAN.md (sitemap, keywords, exclusions); anything ambiguous is excluded and logged in docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. BUILD-NOTES.md there has the edit guide + launch checklist. Design: Source Serif 4 + Public Sans (deliberately NOT Fraunces - midvalleyparenting uses it), deep evergreen accent, tokens in :root of css/site.css. Provisioned 2026-07-24: staging nn.webriculture.com (--no-redirect), primary www.neednavigator.com registered pre-DNS so staging stays non-primary; forms feature enabled; tests in tests/Feature/NeedNavigatorSiteTest.php pin the staging-canonical invariant. Legacy /pages/{slug} URLs get 301s via redirect map at DNS cutover. Reuse platform Turnstile widget (hostnames added in Cloudflare by Dave).
